method: Per-chapter content audit of the source specs (Docs 01–19, docs/purescore/*.md) for BUILD-READINESS: could a competent engineer implement exactly what is written without guessing? Scope excludes product/app-surface gaps (auth, offline, analytics) — those live in the Production-readiness page. blocker = cannot implement as written; major = ambiguous / likely-wrong guess; minor = clarity / edge case.

findings.gap: Low-side risk penalty given only as “mirror of the above”; undefined for one-sided and negative-anchored markers (e.g. BMD T-score ≤ −2.5), and the saturating denominator for the low side is unspecified.
findings.fix: State the explicit low-side formula with a scale-safe, width-based denominator that is defined for negative anchors.

findings.gap: In-green “gentle gradient” r_green∈[0,0.15) toward m_i has no formula, and contradicts the piecewise branch that sets r=0 on [L,U].
findings.fix: Supply the in-green function and reconcile it with the green-core r=0 branch.

findings.gap: Cohort risk r_cohort=g(q_i) given only qualitatively (g(0.5)=0, rises toward tails). No functional form, slope, or two-sided handling — Stage-2 output is uncomputable.
findings.fix: Pin g (e.g. piecewise/logistic in percentile) with stated parameters.

findings.gap: Reservoir state equation depends on κ_in, inflow a/b, λ_j (only “weeks–months”), B*, B_max, B_target and the full κ_jl matrix — all deferred to Doc 13 with no values. No reservoir can advance one step.
findings.fix: Ship a default parameter table, or explicitly mark Doc 04 non-buildable without the Doc 13 calibration set.

findings.gap: B̃_k needs link weights u_kj (only which pillars listed, not weights); no normalization of u, and the asset term 1−B_j/B_target can go negative with no clamp.
findings.fix: Provide the u_kj values and per-term clamping.

findings.gap: band_clamp is load-bearing but never defined — its band edges on the continuous r-scale and composition with max(...) are unspecified.
findings.fix: Define band_clamp(r) precisely (edges + clamp behaviour).

findings.gap: ŵ_i = w_i·confidence_i, but confidence_i scale/inputs are deferred to Doc 06 §2; pillar aggregation can't run without it.
findings.fix: Define confidence ∈ [0,1] and its inputs, or inline the Doc 06 definition.

findings.gap: “Low coverage caps how green a pillar may be displayed” — cap value/threshold is prose only.
findings.fix: Pin the coverage threshold and the display-cap formula.

findings.gap: Power-mean divides by Σŵ_i; if all markers in a pillar are unobserved (or confidences 0), denominator = 0. No empty-pillar rule.
findings.fix: Specify behaviour when Σŵ_i = 0 (reservoir-only, or INSUFFICIENT).

findings.gap: Doc 03 §4 assumes a machine-readable critical/escalation flag per marker, but Doc 02 marks criticality inconsistently and has no escalation∈{emergency,urgent,routine} column. The critical set is not unambiguously derivable.
findings.fix: Add explicit critical + escalation columns to every Doc 02 table.

findings.gap: Managed-state / confounder logic depends on drug_targets(i,Mx) and confounds(drug,marker) tables (contents, classes, per-pair c_conf) that are referenced but not provided.
findings.fix: Supply these tables (or cite a provided data file).

findings.gap: Companion-dimension features defined only qualitatively: stability_k, meanConf_k, Tr_k (which slope estimator/window?), Vo_k (window?), Mo_k (how partitioned?), Rp_k (which distance, scaled how to 0–100?).
findings.fix: Give concrete estimators, windows and scalings for each.

findings.gap: St = 100·σ(a·B̄_ALLO + b·z_auto) and the Watch-raise logic depend on coefficients a, b (undefined) and tier cut-points (unspecified).
findings.fix: Pin a, b and the low/elevated/high tier thresholds.

findings.gap: Progress formula uses PureScore_floor which is never defined; can divide by zero if PureScore_max = PureScore_floor.
findings.fix: Define PureScore_floor and guard the denominator.

findings.gap: Ladder uses mild/high D_M and an Advisory D_M* that is “χ²-based per cohort” with no df/α; mild vs high cutoffs unpinned.
findings.fix: Give χ² df and α per tier (e.g. df=#markers, α=0.01).

findings.gap: W_k^base defaults and the cohort/goal/acute multiplier magnitudes are qualitative; values deferred to Docs 03/09/13. PureScore weighting not reproducible.
findings.fix: Include the base weight vector and multiplier values/ranges.

findings.gap: A non-critical marker with r_i≥0.5 but pillar R_k<0.60 can fall through with no rule forcing at least yellow.
findings.fix: Add explicit handling for non-critical r_i≥0.5.

findings.gap: Interference uses sat(B_l) but sat() form/parameters are never given.
findings.fix: Define sat().

findings.gap: Sex-hormone row has weight .34 but bands are “see Doc 08 / —”; power mean can't include it without Doc 08.
findings.fix: Note these markers are gated until Doc 08 bands load.

findings.gap: Text cites decisions “D1–D12” but the body references D13, D14, D22, D24.
findings.fix: Correct the decision range.

findings.gap: z_i = sign_adverse·(…) needs a per-marker adverse direction; two-sided markers have no single sign.
findings.fix: Specify z_i for two-sided markers (e.g. distance from m_i).

findings.gap: q_source given as ranges (clinical 0.85–1.0, consumer 0.6–0.8, survey 0.5–0.7, literature 0.2–0.4) with no rule assigning a point value per source/device. confidence_i(t) is uncomputable.
findings.fix: Define an exact q_source per source enum / device-grade.

findings.gap: Recency decay τ_i never quantified (“glucose hours–days, HbA1c weeks–months, permanent”). The decay term is uncomputable.
findings.fix: Table mapping each decay_class to a numeric τ.

findings.gap: Per-marker staleness floor (below which a marker is “stale”) has no value/source.
findings.fix: Define the floor per marker / decay_class.

findings.gap: r_i = max(r_clinical, φ·r_cohort) with φ<1 unspecified, and r_clinical/r_cohort computation deferred to Doc 03 §2 — core risk number can't be produced standalone.
findings.fix: Pin φ and confirm Doc 03 §2 fully defines the band→risk mapping.

findings.gap: MarkerDef stores optimal/yellow/red band functions with no signature (args? sex/age/cohort params? return = interval?), and no two-band representation for two-sided markers.
findings.fix: Define the band-function signature + return type and the two-sided representation.

findings.gap: Inferential/derived wearables are “excluded from band-setting” and get no q_source tier, yet Doc 07 says they feed trajectory/nudges — their non-band weighting is undefined.
findings.fix: Specify weight/handling for inferential metrics in non-band contexts.

findings.gap: Percentile F_{i,c} “stratified by age × sex (× condition)” has no age-band edges, no cohort-selection precedence when condition present, no fallback when no matching cohort exists.
findings.fix: Define age-band edges and cohort-selection precedence + fallback.

findings.gap: ReferenceDist as CDF | {median, p10..p90} has no interpolation rule between percentiles, no behaviour outside p10/p90, and inverse-CDF method unspecified.
findings.fix: Define interpolation + tail handling and the inverse-CDF method.

findings.gap: Ingestion “rejects out-of-physiological-range values” but no per-marker physiological min/max is defined.
findings.fix: Add physiological bounds to MarkerDef.

findings.gap: Anti-gaming plausibility checks (“implausible step counts, HR/HRV inconsistency”) have no thresholds, no consistency formula, no failure action.
findings.fix: Define concrete plausibility rules + outcome.

findings.gap: Wearable streams described qualitatively — no field schema, sampling cadence contract, rollup definitions (resting HR / TIR / sleep-regularity), or multi-device dedup/precedence. The intake layer can't be built.
findings.fix: Add per-metric schema, aggregation formulas, and dedup/precedence.

findings.gap: MarkerDef fields w_i (source/range), tier enum, reservoir_links[] target, decay_class enum are referenced but never enumerated.
findings.fix: Enumerate allowed values or cross-link the defining doc per field.

findings.gap: Clinical-grade wearable “≈ lab weight” / “discounted” / “informational only” is qualitative; the actual numeric weight feeding the score is undefined (deferred to calibration).
findings.fix: Provide provisional numeric weights or an explicit default.

findings.gap: Literature fallback confidence is “low” (§4.3) vs 0.2–0.4 (§2).
findings.fix: Reconcile to one defined value.

findings.gap: Goal.goal_type, LifeEvent.type, severity scale not enumerated; Goal affects pillar weighting but mapping not present.
findings.fix: Enumerate or cross-reference the defining doc.

findings.gap: “Clinical-grade confirmation required before red/critical” — no definition of what counts as confirmation (markers, window, count).
findings.fix: Define the confirmation criteria.

findings.gap: Core tier lists PHQ-2/GAD-2 but bands cite only PHQ-9/GAD-7 — no band source for the 2-item screeners.
findings.fix: Add PHQ-2/GAD-2 cut-offs or map to PHQ-9/GAD-7.

findings.gap: ASCVD-PCE, SCORE2, Framingham, FINDRISC, KFRE, FRAX, PhenoAge are named with inputs/output bands but NO coefficients, intercepts, baseline survival, or formulas. No clinical score can be computed.
findings.fix: Add per-score coefficient tables (race/sex-stratified PCE; S0; FRAX/PhenoAge) or cite an exact versioned reference implementation.

findings.gap: Feedback “raises m_k^cohort” / “raise w_i” / r_i←max(r_i, score-derived caution) with no quantities — no band→multiplier delta, no band→caution mapping.
findings.fix: Provide a band→m_k^cohort delta table and a band→caution(r_i) function.

findings.gap: Acute exit is θ_exit=0.25 but entry is only “B_ACU ≥ θ_enter·B_max” with no θ_enter and no B_max vs B_peak definition.
findings.fix: Define θ_enter and clarify B_max/B_peak.

findings.gap: Menstrual-phase bands non-contiguous/qualitative (estradiol follicular 20–150, ovulatory 150–400; progesterone “1–3 (rising)”; FSH “mid-rise”). [L_opt(phase),U_opt(phase)] can't be coded deterministically.
findings.fix: Give closed numeric ranges per phase for every marker, incl. FSH ovulatory.

findings.gap: Cycle-regularity feature and PCOS/FHA flags (“irregular/long cycles, ↑LH:FSH”) have no numeric thresholds (variance? ratio? anovulation count?).
findings.fix: Define cut-points for cycle variance, LH:FSH, confirmation rate.

findings.gap: STRAW+10 staging: “engine reads the trajectory” with no window/slope, and FSH “>25–40 IU/L” is a range-as-threshold. The stage classifier is unimplementable.
findings.fix: Specify staging decision rules and a concrete FSH threshold.

findings.gap: Life-stage pillar multipliers m_k^{life-stage} listed only as “Raised (m>1)” with no values; pregnancy reweighting has no magnitudes. W_k renormalization can't be computed.
findings.fix: Provide numeric m_k^{life-stage} per stage/pillar.

findings.gap: BON reservoir λ/inflow “modified by estrogen status; accelerated depletion postmenopause”; male “different λ” — no numeric λ deltas.
findings.fix: Give per-stage/sex λ_BON multipliers.

findings.gap: Event spikes m_k^acute “for each affected pillar, weighted by severity” but A.4 gives a single spike per tier (×1.2/1.5/2.0) — no multi-pillar severity weighting (sepsis → INF+HEM+REN+MET).
findings.fix: Define the per-pillar severity weighting rule.

findings.gap: Acute reservoir B_ACU drain λ given only as “days–weeks”, inject as “small/moderate/large”; magnitude, u_{k,ACU} coupling, λ_ACU per class have no numbers — recovery clock/revert can't be computed.
findings.fix: Numeric λ_ACU, inject magnitudes per class/tier, and u_{k,ACU}.

findings.gap: Confirmation/ramp windows τ_dwell (“e.g. 48–72 h”) and τ_ramp are example ranges only, not bound per class.
findings.fix: Bind τ_dwell/τ_ramp per event class.

findings.gap: Pre-eclampsia cascade gated by gestational_age ≥ 20 wk, but §5.2 says “BP ≥160/110 alone ⇒ EMERGENCY” without the qualifier; <20-wk severe HTN unaddressed.
findings.fix: State handling for severe BP before 20 wk.

findings.gap: EPDS cut-offs given, but lactation nutrition targets and post-partum thyroid TSH/FT4 bands carry no numbers.
findings.fix: Provide lactation targets and PP TSH/FT4 bands.

findings.gap: Doc 08 numbering jumps §1.1→§1.3 (no §1.2); Doc 10 cites a §1.2 that doesn't exist.
findings.fix: Renumber or add §1.2.

findings.gap: KDIGO heatmap → only “orange/red raises m_REN^cohort”; no per-cell-colour multiplier mapping.
findings.fix: Map each KDIGO colour to a feedback magnitude.

findings.gap: Wearable acute detection (“resting-HR step-up”, “HRV collapse”, “activity collapse ≫ personal variance”) has no numeric/statistical thresholds.
findings.fix: Define thresholds (e.g. Δ vs N-day baseline in SDs).

findings.gap: μ (diversity/redundancy penalty) is “tuned” with no value, yet it determines which 5 actions are selected (a*=argmax U_a − μ·redundancy). Selection is non-deterministic.
findings.fix: Pin a default μ and its scale relative to U_a.

findings.gap: redundancy(a, selected) is qualitative (“high if shares class/valve/pillar”) — no formula or weights. With μ undefined the penalty term is unimplementable.
findings.fix: Define redundancy (weighted count of shared class/valve/pillar) with numeric weights.

findings.gap: p̂_a=σ(θ·z) never defines the feature encoding, θ init, cohort base-rate table, or empirical-Bayes shrinkage strength. Cold-start base rate has no source.
findings.fix: Specify feature encoding, prior/shrinkage params, and the cohort base-rate source.

findings.gap: “Constraint-aware override” reserves a slot when a pillar is “binding (large (a)·(b) gradient)” — no threshold for “large”, and no precedence among override / class-cap (≤2) / ≥1-near-zero-effort when they conflict.
findings.fix: Define the gradient threshold and a strict precedence ordering of the four constraints.

findings.gap: Realization curve g_a(h) (every impact quote + ranking depends on it) is “consistent with λ_j” but its functional form is never given.
findings.fix: Specify the g_a(h) parametric form and its derivation from λ_j.

findings.gap: ν_a bundles novelty bonus, care-gap/binding bonus, anti-nag decay, goal-alignment bonus into one factor with no decomposition, decay rate, or magnitudes.
findings.fix: Define each ν_a component as a numeric multiplier / decay schedule.

findings.gap: Daily budget is “≤5 surfaced” but §9.5 sets “per-day push ceiling (default 2)” + one digest. Relation between 5 actions, 1 digest, 2 pushes is unspecified.
findings.fix: Reconcile surfaced-count vs push-count vs digest semantics.

findings.gap: Goal-alignment bonus “lifts actions that advance the goal” with no lift quantity and no goal→action matching predicate (pillar match? class match?).
findings.fix: Specify the matching predicate and bonus size.

findings.gap: §5.2 suppresses the tips card on any emergency/urgent red, but criticals are “confirmation-gated upstream”. Behaviour for an unconfirmed red (card shown or not, what the patient sees) is unspecified.
findings.fix: Define behaviour for the unconfirmed-red state re: card suppression.

findings.gap: “At least one near-zero-effort action is always included” — “near-zero-effort” has no E_a threshold.
findings.fix: Pin the effort threshold defining a free win.

findings.gap: Doc 12 classes include VACCINE, SCREEN but Doc 11's class_a enum omits them; the class-cap/diversity logic operates on class_a, so undefined classes break the cap.
findings.fix: Reconcile the canonical class enum across both docs.

findings.gap: G6PD-AVOID “hard safety filter” has no predicate wired to specific action IDs (which catalogue rows it blocks, e.g. high-dose vit C).
findings.fix: Enumerate the action IDs the G6PD filter blocks/flags.

findings.gap: Critical “no ack within ack_TTL → human escalation”, but with per-channel reachability provisional, what counts as “total channel failure” for immediate escalation vs waiting for TTL is undefined.
findings.fix: Define the channel-failure detection rule and its relation to ack_TTL.

findings.gap: α,β,η defaults given, but exponents apply to terms of different scales (ΔPureScore points vs p̂∈[0,1] vs (1−E)) with no ΔPureScore normalization, so U_a scaling is ambiguous.
findings.fix: Specify whether ΔPureScore is normalized before exponentiation.

findings.gap: De-confounding realized Δ “using the reservoir equations as the counterfactual baseline” has no attribution/causal estimator.
findings.fix: Specify the counterfactual computation.

findings.gap: Ramadan suppression of food/med-timing nudges vs a safety-critical glucose <70 break-fast nudge during fasting — precedence is implied, not stated.
findings.fix: State explicitly that safety-critical overrides fasting-window suppression.

findings.gap: No acceptance criteria for engine output: behaviour when <5 positive-Δ safe actions exist, or 0 actions pass safety in a non-critical state (the all-blocked case).
findings.fix: Add empty/under-filled-list acceptance behaviour.

findings.gap: INF vs INFL token used inconsistently (B_INFL vs pillar INF); ENDO/HEM/HEPF/B_BON referenced but defined in Docs 02/04.
findings.fix: Normalize the INF/INFL token.

findings.gap: n_min=200, ≥30-with-shrinkage, n_min(q)≈n_min/[q(1−q)] are labelled illustrative with no committed per-marker values. Can't decide when a cohort cell is usable vs pooled.
findings.fix: Ship a versioned per-marker n_min / tail-floor table with sign-off.

findings.gap: Every calibration/fairness tolerance is a symbol with no value (|E/O−1|≤tol, ECE≤tol, C≥target, ICC≥target, error-parity gap≤tol); Doc 14 fixes numbers only for the demo. The binding release gate can't be evaluated.
findings.fix: Publish the numeric target/tol table per metric and population.

findings.gap: Emergency sensitivity is “e.g. ≥0.99” and false-reassurance “≈0” — no binding threshold or CI requirement for the most safety-critical gate.
findings.fix: Fix a binding minimum sensitivity (with CI lower-bound rule) and a literal max false-reassurance count.

findings.gap: Advisory gate must “clear a minimum-PPV bar”; alarm budget “≤~1/patient-month (illustrative)”; deployment prevalence π undefined though PPV depends on it. The early-warning gate is uncomputable.
findings.fix: Commit PPV floor, alarm budget, and a sourced prevalence per marker/population.

findings.gap: Escalation tiers mix concrete cuts (K⁺ ≥5.6/≤3.2, SpO2<92) with non-thresholds (“hsCRP/WBC sepsis screen”, “BP ≥180/120 region”, “ALT/AST >3× ULN” with no ULN source). Sepsis-screen/“region” triggers can't be implemented.
findings.fix: Give exact numeric/logic triggers (or cite Doc 02 rule IDs) for every example.

findings.gap: Reference dataset named only by class (“NHANES / UK-Biobank-class + disease registries”) — no versions, access, local cohort, or per-disease registry. Percentiles aren't reproducible.
findings.fix: Enumerate exact datasets/versions/registries with ReferenceDist vintages.

findings.gap: Calibration loss/horizon h, Cox vs discrete-time choice, regularization weights R_λ/R_κ/R_W, and per-reservoir λ bands are unspecified. The fit is not reproducible.
findings.fix: Specify loss form, h, penalty weights/selection, and per-reservoir λ bounds.

findings.gap: Stability gate needs max Re(eig) ≤ −ε and ρ(I+Δ·J)<1, but neither ε nor Δ (deferred to Doc 04 §7) is valued. Binding gate not evaluable.
findings.fix: State ε and reference the concrete Δ value.

findings.gap: σ_i², τ_i², k_pers/k_coh: REML/MoM named but the cross-tree estimation procedure and ignition prior strengths have no values/recipe. Shrinkage weights can't be computed.
findings.fix: Specify estimators and commit the prior-strength constants.

findings.gap: Indirect objects O1 (does low Cf predict larger error?) and O5 (variance estimate calibrated) have no monotonicity statistic or pass threshold.
findings.fix: Define the test statistic and pass bound for each indirect object.

findings.gap: θ_pers “gated by personal-baseline quality (volatility, coverage)” and low representativeness “suppresses θ_coh (φ→0)” give direction but no functional form/thresholds. The ignition blend isn't computable.
findings.fix: Specify the gating functions and cut-points.

findings.gap: FDA CDS four-criteria and MDR Rule 11 / MDCG 2019-11 framing carry a blanket “re-verify with counsel” and no citations; the classification gate can't be self-served.
findings.fix: Cite the controlling statute/guidance sections; treat as an external dependency.

findings.gap: Crawler “values never auto-change”, 30-day cadence, dead-source→Confidence↓ given, but no rule for how long a seed/last_verified:null band may ship, or conflicting guideline bodies.
findings.fix: Define a max-unverified-age gate and multi-body conflict resolution.

findings.gap: INSUFFICIENT “fires iff fresh-data fraction < τ_su” with no value.
findings.fix: Commit τ_su.

findings.gap: Drift formula Σ(p−q)·ln(p/q) is symmetric PSI, but Doc 13 §4.7 lists PSI and KL as distinct tests; thresholds 0.1/0.25 given only for PSI.
findings.fix: Name the exact statistic for each threshold.

findings.gap: Evidence grade (A/B/C/GRADE) “feeds ε_a/Confidence” with no mapping function.
findings.fix: Give the grade→ε_a table.

findings.gap: FMEA RPN = S×L×D is qualitative; only “any S=5 row without green mitigation blocks” is binding — RPN otherwise drives nothing testable.
findings.fix: Define RPN action thresholds or state RPN is advisory-only.

findings.gap: OOD method left as a menu (Mahalanobis OR conformal OR isolation-forest) with no selection rule or cut-point.
findings.fix: Pick the method + threshold (or a per-marker rule).

findings.gap: Cost model Ĉ(c)=baseline·Πμ_k·μ_res·μ_clin·TREND gives no coefficients (β_k, β_res, β_m), no dataset, no link-function default, no worked example.
findings.fix: Supply fitted relativities (or the dataset + GLM spec to fit them).

findings.gap: Bühlmann K=EPV/VHM “estimated from the book (Doc 13)” but neither doc supplies values nor an estimation procedure; K is required for credibility Z.
findings.fix: Provide K (or the estimation recipe + inputs).

findings.gap: “Calibration of constants (shrinkage k, reservoir κ/λ, anomaly thresholds, benefit weights) awaits real cohort data.” Every numeric constant the engine needs is explicitly unfitted.
findings.fix: Source the calibration cohort; until then the engine produces unvalidated output (the systemic blocker — see callout).

findings.gap: μ_k clamp band [0.7,1.6] is “e.g.” and “tighter in individual-affecting contexts” — the tighter value is never specified.
findings.fix: Specify the individual-affecting clamp band.

findings.gap: HIPAA/ADA wellness incentive caps quoted as “~30%, ~50% tobacco” with “re-verify current EEOC/HHS limits before any incentive ships.”
findings.fix: Confirm current caps with counsel; gate any incentive feature on it.

findings.gap: QRISK3 named as the ethnicity-aware equation but no coefficients/thresholds; “consider earlier statin/screening” has no numeric trigger.
findings.fix: Supply QRISK3 coefficients and the earlier-intervention cut-points.

findings.gap: Ramadan risk tiers (very-high/high/moderate/low → “fasting inadvisable”) have no mapping rule from patient state to tier (glucose <70/>300 override is concrete; IDF-DAR category logic is not).
findings.fix: Define the IDF-DAR risk-category assignment logic.

findings.gap: Gulf/other-Arab assigned WHO-Asian BMI/IDF-waist cut-points while the doc flags the evidence as “emerging” — no clinical-sign-off gate attached to shipping them for that subgroup.
findings.fix: Attach a clinical-sign-off gate; mark provisional.

findings.gap: Disparate-impact testing cites four-fifths rule “plus statistical tests” and calibration-within-group, but no significance thresholds, named tests, or remediation trigger.
findings.fix: Name the tests, thresholds, and the “halt and remediate” trigger values.

findings.gap: Multiple residual blockers enumerated as known-open with no owner/date: “No gate satisfied yet”, “thresholds need prevalence-specific calibration”, “unit-detection specified not built”, “crawler/CI specified not built”, “coupling κ / decay λ need calibration.”
findings.fix: Assign owner + date to each red-team residual; track to closure.

findings.gap: “File before you price / no unfiled factor prices” spans US state DOI, EU IDD/POG, Solvency II, UK FCA with no per-jurisdiction filing specifics; repeatedly defers to “verify per deployment”.
findings.fix: Resolve per-jurisdiction filing requirements with licensed actuarial sign-off before a regulated launch.

findings.gap: Trajectory feature h(B̃)=a·B̃+b·(dB̃/dt) introduces a,b with no values and no §8 constants entry.
findings.fix: Add a,b to the constants table.

findings.gap: Shared-savings α is “contracted; gated on quality/access” with no default and no measurement thresholds for the quality/access gates.
findings.fix: Provide a default α and the gate thresholds.

findings.gap: “Personas southasian/ramadan_dm; ethTier() applies cut-points in band()” describes live-calculator state, but Doc 17 §B/§K2 says only a marker subset is wired live — no single source of truth for what's implemented.
findings.fix: Maintain one source of truth for live coverage.

findings.gap: Principles “incentive must improve the score, never deny” and “no false-reassurance failures” are build requirements with no acceptance metric defined or cross-referenced to a concrete gate.
findings.fix: Cross-reference each principle to a measurable gate (e.g. the Doc 13 false-reassurance bar).

findings.gap: Risk-adjustment cross-referenced as “§1.1.2” but §1.1 is a numbered list with no §1.1.2 anchor.
findings.fix: Fix the citation anchor.
